_comment: Known-risk reference for the SOFT risk scorer. The LLM judge uses these as a checklist: a high-quality proposal should surface and mitigate the relevant risks for the scenario. Keyed by client id, plus a generic bank.
generic: Model drift / degradation of accuracy over time without monitoring
Hidden integration costs with legacy systems
Lack of human-in-the-loop for high-stakes decisions

meridian-insurer: PHI leakage if any processing touches third-party cloud (HIPAA breach)
Bias in fraud detection leading to wrongful claim denials and regulatory exposure
On-prem hardware capacity and maintenance burden underestimated
Auditability: claims decisions must be explainable to regulators
Data residency violation if backups or telemetry leave the US
northwind-retail: Dynamic pricing triggering price-discrimination / fairness complaints
Forecasting failures during demand shocks (e.g. promotions, seasonality)
Customer-assistant hallucination giving wrong product or returns info
PII handling in customer support transcripts
atlas-bank: Credit-risk model bias creating fair-lending (ECOA) violations
Model explainability required for adverse-action notices
Core banking data exposure in multi-tenant cloud
SOC 2 scope gaps if vendor cert excludes the relevant trust criteria
